title: A high-fidelity intimate portrait photog
prompt:
A high-fidelity intimate portrait photograph captured on a 50mm prime lens — a chest-up close portrait of an exceptionally gorgeous young East Asian woman looking directly into the camera with a calm, alluring, and tender expression.

She possesses top-tier celebrity beauty with a delicate oval face, clear expressive dark eyes, refined bone structure, and soft hydrated pink lips. Her dark black hair is loosely gathered into an effortless updo secured with a minimalist hairpin, leaving soft wispy tendrils falling gently along her cheeks and neck. She wears a semi-sheer pastel-pink lightweight robe featuring delicate white floral embroidery, draped loosely off her right shoulder to reveal smooth bare collarbones and natural shoulder contours.

The setting is an understated studio space against a neutral warm-gray textured plaster wall. Soft diffuse window light from camera-left sculpts her features with subtle, physically accurate shadow transitions across her jaw and neck, giving the frame an organic, intimate stillness.

Captured at f/1.8 with natural shallow depth of field, gentle highlight roll-off, and fine 35mm film grain in an M2 intimate studio portrait register. Genuine human skin with delicate fine pores, subtle peach fuzz along the jawline, and natural biological subsurface scattering — strictly no CGI, no 3D render, no plastic skin, no artificial beauty smoothing, no waxy AI texture.
